channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio sugeriram ideia de carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro had suggested in private that Jair Bolsonaro should write a letter to his son before the former president actually produced the manuscript in which he calls Flávio 'my spokesperson'. The initiative came from members of the 'Zero Um' group, who saw the letter as a way to strengthen Flávio's image in the political landscape. The information was disclosed in a subscriber-only article.

item.title: Valdemar sobre Michelle ao Senado no DF: "Acho que sai e fica em 1º"
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated he believes Michelle Bolsonaro will run for the Federal Senate from the Distrito Federal and win in first place. He said she initially refused to run but changed her mind after their conversation. Valdemar also urged Michelle to campaign alongside Flávio Bolsonaro to prevent Jair Bolsonaro from remaining imprisoned for another 10 years.

item.title: Flávio erra conta ao falar de tarifas da China sobre carne brasileira
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) incorrectly stated that China’s tariff on Brazilian beef would be 62%, when the correct calculation is 67% (55% additional + 12% existing). He said he will seek to reverse the measure through the Chinese Embassy in Brazil and blamed President Lula for the challenges faced by the export sector, claiming the decision stems from Brazilian government incompetence.

item.title: Flávio propõe voucher em caso de falta de vagas em creches públicas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed a voucher system for private daycare enrollment when public spots are unavailable, aiming to increase mothers' — especially heads of household — access to the labor market. The proposal was announced during a PL event in Fortaleza (CE), where he also advocated for community-based daycare centers near residential areas. He cited 2025 Gaepe-Brasil/MEC data showing 826,371 Brazilian children on waiting lists for daycare, a 30.6% increase from 2024.

item.title: Sem camisa, Lula posta vídeo na esteira e pede: “Cuidem da saúde”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva posted a shirtless video on Instagram walking and running on a treadmill, encouraging physical activity and stating that taking care of one's health is the best cause for aging with quality of life. He noted that he can now perform exercises he couldn't do in 2003 at age 57, and urged people to set aside morning time for walking, even if only for a few minutes.

item.title: Tarcísio resolve questão de matemática do ITA e desafia alunos
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas posted a video solving a mathematics question from the ITA 2027 entrance exam, encouraging candidates to practice with past papers. He concluded the correct answer is 'n = 9' and referenced his military and civil engineering background. ITA 2027 registrations remain open until July 12, 2026.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai à Embaixada da China contra tarifa à carne brasileira
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, stated he plans to visit China’s embassy in Brazil to request a review of a 55% tariff on Brazilian beef, which, combined with a 12% base rate, results in 62% taxation when export quotas are exceeded. He blamed the Lula government for losing access to the European market due to sanitary failures and said he tried to prevent U.S. tariffs, though he viewed the decision as political. The Chinese tariff, effective January 1, 2026, lasts three years and grants Brazil a duty-free quota of 1.1 million tons in 2026.

item.title: Moraes concede liberdade provisória a ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso com fuzil da PM em casa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes granted provisional release to former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella, arrested for illegal possession of a military police rifle. Canella is under precautionary measures, including an electronic anklet and nighttime home confinement. He resigned as mayor to run for Senate in 2026 and is under investigation in Operation Unha e Carne for alleged money laundering of R$7.6 billion.

item.title: Jair Bolsonaro pede união em torno da candidatura de Flávio
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro urged his allies to unite behind the presidential candidacy of his eldest son, Flávio Bolsonaro, for the 2026 elections, amid internal tensions with former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, who is also reportedly interested in running. The appeal comes as the Bolsonaro family faces divisions over who should lead the conservative ticket in the upcoming election.

item.title: Zema critica 'solução paliativa' para ameaça de tarifaço após cobrança de Flávio a adversários sobre ida aos EUA
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized the creation of a 'palliative solution' to the threat of new U.S. tariffs, advocating for a definitive resolution instead of extensions. He noted he was not invited to the USTR hearing in Washington, where Flávio Bolsonaro participated and urged other presidential pre-candidates to attend and defend Brazil's interests.

item.title: Motta chama decisão de Dino sobre emendas de “indevida intervenção”
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta criticized Minister Flávio Dino’s STF decision blocking parliamentary amendments proposed by Liberal Party leader Valdemar Costa Neto, calling it an 'undue judicial intervention'. Motta defended the amendments as legally compliant and argued that parliamentary staff acting under party direction is normal administrative practice. Dino, however, cited 'convergent indications' of a scheme to improperly redirect R$119 million in amendments involving Chamber officials and Valdemar Costa Neto.

item.title: Sem camisa, Lula posta vídeo na esteira e dá recado: "Cuidar da saúde"
item.description: President Lula posted a video showing himself exercising on a treadmill, revealing he walked and ran for 40 minutes, including 10 minutes at 8 km/h. He noted he couldn't perform such activity when he took office in 2003 at age 57, and now, at 81, uses his fitness routine to demonstrate vitality ahead of the 2026 elections. Lula urged Brazilians to prioritize health, stating 'there is no better cause than taking care of your health' and encouraging daily walks as a form of personal struggle and longevity.

item.title: Lula não convence aliadas e terá palanque frágil em Goiás
item.description: Lula attempted to persuade Adriana Accorsi (PT-GO) and Aava Santiago (PSB-GO) to form a female-majority ticket in Goiás to strengthen his electoral base, but both declined and chose to run for re-election as federal deputies. Their refusal weakens the PT's strategy, as current pre-candidate Luís César Bueno polls at only 5%, eliminating the chance for a runoff. The PT also ruled out an alliance with Marconi Perillo (PSDB) due to the party's opposition to the federal government.

item.title: Milei confirma vinda ao Brasil para apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei confirmed a visit to Brazil in late July to attend the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) presidential pre-candidacy and to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest. The trip is part of a broader regional agenda that includes inaugurations of right-wing leaders in Peru and Colombia, highlighting the international coordination of the Latin American right ahead of Brazil’s 2026 elections.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro minimiza crise familiar e declara Flávio seu ‘porta-voz’
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro declared, in a letter read by his son Flávio Bolsonaro during a live stream, that he trusts him as his 'spokesperson' to 'rescue Brazil'. The statement came amid a public family rift involving Flávio and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, marked by disputes over political alliances and mutual accusations, which led to her resignation from the PL Women's presidency. Bolsonaro urged that 'possible differences' be set aside for family and political unity.

item.title: “Querem prejudicar a direita. Essa é a guerra”, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, accused Justice Minister Flávio Dino of leading an operation that harms the right-wing, claiming it is part of a war to undermine the party's electoral prospects. He linked the suspension of parliamentary amendments to a poll showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of President Lula in a potential runoff, stating that Lula has already lost the election due to declining support in the Northeast and public dissatisfaction with the economy.

item.title: “Agricultor, eu nem sabia que eu era”, diz Lula ao colher milho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was filmed harvesting organic corn in a video shared by First Lady Janja Lula da Silva on Instagram, where he described himself as a 'farmer' and emphasized his routine of harvesting crops like cassava and corn. The video, part of a series showcasing Lula’s daily life after the start of the electoral blackout period, shows him engaging in rural activities during a weekend in São Paulo with no official engagements. The effort aims to humanize the president’s image amid institutional communication restrictions during the election period.

item.title: Bolsonaro diz que Flávio é seu ‘porta-voz’ em carta lida por pré-candidato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter attributed to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in which the former president designates him as his 'spokesperson' in the 2026 presidential pre-campaign. The letter was read during a live broadcast, after Flávio described weekly visits to his father under house arrest and mentioned efforts to use political influence to avoid U.S. tariffs before the election. He also reiterated claims of campaign disunity and tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro, without naming her directly.

item.title: Hugo Motta diz que decisão de Dino sobre Valdemar é ‘indevida intervenção judicial’
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta criticized the STF minister Flávio Dino's decision to freeze R$119 million from PL leader Valdemar Costa Neto's accounts over alleged illicit interference in parliamentary amendments, calling it an 'undue judicial intervention'. Motta argued the amendment allocation complies with current regulations and inter-institutional agreements, and expressed confidence in the civil servants involved.

item.title: Motta diz que decisão de Dino contra Valdemar é 'indevida intervenção judicial' no Parlamento
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta criticized Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino's decision to block R$119 million in parliamentary amendments linked to PL president Valdemar Costa Neto over alleged misuse, calling it an 'undue judicial intervention'. Motta defended the lawmaker and congressional staff, arguing the measure undermines legislative autonomy.

item.title: Flávio copia Lula e divulga ‘Carta aos Brasileiros’ assinada pelo pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released a 'Letter to Brazilians' handwritten and signed by his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, to enforce unity behind his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy amid internal divisions in the PL party. The letter urges supporters to set aside differences and back Flávio as the trusted 'spokesperson' to rescue Brazil from corruption, violence, and impoverishment. Flávio set a deadline for party realignment and mobilized digital grassroots activists to counter perceived boycotts and inertia among some allies.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da carta em que Bolsonaro chama Flávio de "melhor opção"
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro released a letter supporting his son Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy, calling him the 'best option' and 'spokesperson' to fight corruption, violence, and impoverishment. The statement followed a family rift involving Michelle Bolsonaro, who resigned from PL Women's presidency after alleging disrespect from Flávio, which he denied. The letter was read during a live broadcast while the former president serves house arrest for his conviction related to the coup attempt.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro diz que Flávio é seu ‘porta-voz’
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro declared, in a letter published by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, that his son is his "spokesperson" and pre-candidate for president in 2026, calling for unity amid reported tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro. The statement comes amid a family and political rift, after Michelle alleged she was humiliated by Flávio and left the PL Women’s wing. Jair Bolsonaro positioned Flávio as the best option to combat corruption, violence, and impoverishment in Brazil.

item.title: Hugo Motta critica interferência judicial na atividade do Poder Legislativo
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, criticized a judicial decision that seeks to criminalize political activity by questioning the allocation of parliamentary amendments, stating there are no irregularities or misappropriation of public funds. He emphasized that the process complies with current regulations and institutional agreements between the Executive and Legislative branches before the STF. Motta also praised the technical work of Chamber staff and reaffirmed the institution’s commitment to transparency, independence, and respect for the legal order.

item.title: Flávio lê carta de Bolsonaro: “O momento é de arregaçar as mangas”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro during a YouTube livestream, in which the father called for unity around his presidential pre-candidacy. The message stressed the need for mobilization and concrete action, using the phrase 'The moment is to roll up our sleeves'. Flávio reiterated his support for his father's candidacy prior to reading the letter.

item.title: Em carta, Jair Bolsonaro endossa Flávio como candidato e seu porta-voz
item.description: In a letter released on Saturday (July 11, 2026), former President Jair Bolsonaro endorsed his eldest son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), as the pre-candidate for the Presidency of Brazil and his 'spokesperson'. The document presents Flávio as the 'best option to rid Brazil of corruption, violence, and impoverishment', reaffirming the former president's trust in his son to 'rescue Brazil and lead us to peace and prosperity'.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro pede união em torno de Flávio após atrito com Michelle
item.description: In a letter read by Flávio Bolsonaro, former President Jair Bolsonaro calls for unity around his son's presidential candidacy following tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro over political maneuvers in Ceará. Bolsonaro endorses Flávio as the 'best option' to free Brazil from corruption, violence, and impoverishment, appointing him as his 'spokesperson'. Flávio says he was tasked with preventing conflicting statements in the pre-campaign.

item.title: O preço do isolamento na ANP
item.description: The isolation of ANP's director-general Artur Watt reveals a leadership crisis within the regulatory agency, marked by internal resistance and lack of political backing from the federal government. This is delaying strategic decisions on fuel programs, pre-sal gas, refining, and market oversight, increasing judicialization risks and undermining the predictability needed to attract private investment.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da carta de Bolsonaro lida por Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter attributed to former President Jair Bolsonaro, expressing support for his son's presidential pre-candidacy and describing him as his 'spokesperson' and the best option to rid Brazil of corruption, violence, and impoverishment. Flávio stated the message aims to unite supporters and prevent conflicting statements in the pre-campaign, emphasizing he received from his father the mission to lead the process coherently.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro pede que "diferenças sejam deixadas de lado"
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro wrote a letter urging that internal differences be set aside to support the presidential pre-candidacy of his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, the official candidate of the PL party. The former president called on supporters to rally behind Flávio, whom he sees as the best option to combat corruption, violence, and impoverishment in Brazil. The letter was released amid a family rift involving Michelle Bolsonaro and was read by Flávio during a live stream following a visit to his father, who is under house arrest.

item.title: Em carta lida por Flávio, Bolsonaro reforça apoio ao filho: 'Momento de deixar de lado as diferenças'
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro wrote a letter read by his son Flávio Bolsonaro, calling for unity within the bolsonarist movement behind Flávio's 2026 presidential pre-candidacy. The former president designated Flávio as his political representative and spokesperson, urging supporters to set aside differences to fight corruption, violence, and impoverishment. Flávio stated the letter aims to end speculation and parallel movements against his campaign, while serving as an ultimatum to hesitant allies.

item.title: Em carta, Bolsonaro diz que Flávio é seu 'porta-voz' e pede pra deixar 'de lado diferenças', sem citar briga do filho com Michelle
item.description: In a letter read by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, former President Jair Bolsonaro designated him as his spokesperson and pre-candidate for the presidency, calling for unity and urging to set aside differences, without directly referencing the conflict with Michelle Bolsonaro. The letter comes after a public exchange of accusations between Flávio and Michelle on social media, which led to her resignation from the PL Women’s presidency. Bolsonaro is currently under house arrest following a conviction related to the alleged coup attempt after the 2022 election.

item.title: Motta diz que investigação contra Valdemar tenta 'criminalizar a política'
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta defended Valdemar Costa Neto's parliamentary amendment allocations, stating the Federal Police investigation seeks to 'criminalize politics' and relies solely on inferences without evidence of misappropriation of public funds. He emphasized that the allocations comply with current legislation and institutional agreements between the Executive and Legislative branches, and that parliamentary staff handling such indications is standard administrative practice.

item.title: Bahamas Hotel Club, polêmica casa noturna, encerra atividades em São Paulo
item.description: The Bahamas Hotel Club, a São Paulo nightclub known for adult entertainment and legal controversies, has ceased operations after over 30 years. Founded by Oscar Maroni, dubbed the 'King of the Night,' the venue faced investigations for prostitution facilitation, human trafficking, and organized crime, while also hosting politically charged events, such as distributing beer in support of Lula and organizing Bolsonaro-aligned rallies. Maroni died in December 2025 at age 74 after being diagnosed with Alzheimer's, and the closure was confirmed on January 10, 2025, by Veja São Paulo.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio lê carta do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will read live, at 12:30 PM this Saturday (Jul 11, 2026), a letter from his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, on his YouTube channel. He said he visited his father that morning and that the ex-president is 'well' and 'strong'. Flávio described the document as a 'very important message' for the country, following his participation in the PL candidate launch in Ceará on Friday (Jul 10).

item.title: Edilson Capetinha revela torcida por Messi: "O cara se dedica"
item.description: Edilson Capetinha, the 2002 World Cup winner with Brazil, declared his support for Lionel Messi, praising the Argentine's dedication, competitive spirit, and emotional commitment on the field. He said Messi's level of effort is what he misses most in the Brazilian national team, contrasting it with the team's 'cold' performance in their elimination against Norway in the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Eduardo chama Dino de “comunista totalitário” após operação contra Valdemar
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended PL party leader Valdemar Costa Neto after a Federal Police operation froze R$ 119 million in his assets, accusing Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino of being a 'totalitarian communist'. The operation is part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in parliamentary amendments. Eduardo's remarks reinforce the opposition's narrative of political persecution.

item.title: Piperno afirma que fãs de Neymar devem estar odiando Jorge Jesus
item.description: New Portugal coach Jorge Jesus revealed during his presentation that he had a frank conversation with Neymar during his time at Al-Hilal, telling him 'Tu, finish' (you're done). Journalist Piperno argues that this statement upset Neymar's fans in Brazil, particularly Flamengo supporters, who may now hate Jesus for speaking the truth in a culture of flattery surrounding the star.

item.title: Flávio e apoiadores gritam: “Lula ladrão, seu lugar é na prisão”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and his supporters shouted 'Lula thief, your place is in prison' during the PL's candidacy launch event in Fortaleza, marking the start of Alcides Fernandes' Senate pre-campaign. Flávio claimed criminals are more likely to vote for Lula than Bolsonaro, questioning PT supporters' choices. The incident occurred on July 10, 2026, with André Fernandes and his father Alcides Fernandes present on stage.

item.title: Ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo, Márcio Canella, preso pela PF durante Operação Unha e Carne, deve ser solto neste sábado
item.description: Former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella, arrested by the PF in Operation Unha e Carne for illegal possession of a restricted-use rifle, is set to be released this Saturday following a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. He will be required to wear an electronic ankle monitor and is running as a pre-candidate for the Senate under the União Brasil party with support from Flávio Bolsonaro. The investigation targets a money laundering scheme involving gas stations, with over R$ 7.6 billion in transactions over six years.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro defende Valdemar e chama Dino de 'comunista totalitário' indicado por Lula para 'perseguir adversários'
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro defended PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto after the Federal Police blocked R$119 million in his assets, calling Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino a 'totalitarian communist' appointed by Lula to persecute opponents. He denied receiving requests from Valdemar to direct amendment funds, stating such practices are standard across parties. Flávio Bolsonaro also backed Valdemar, accusing the PF of selective action against government opponents.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso em operação da PF com fuzil no carro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of Márcio Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and Senate pre-candidate for União Brasil, who was arrested with an AR-15-style .556 rifle in his car during Operation Unha e Carne. Canella’s defense stated the weapon was legally registered to his security detail, which supported the judge’s ruling. The PF investigation targets an alleged money-laundering scheme through gas stations, involving R$ 7.6 billion over six years.

item.title: Candidato do PL ao Senado impulsiona conteúdo negativo contra o PT, proibido por lei eleitoral
item.description: Filipe Barros (PL-PR), a pre-candidate for the Senate in Paraná, boosted negative content against the PT and President Lula on social media, a practice prohibited by Brazilian electoral law. The action is already being monitored by political opponents and may constitute economic abuse or improper use of communication channels. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights the illegality of this premature campaign strategy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se vacina contra o PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) performed a symbolic 'vaccination' against the PT during an event with allies in Ceará on Friday, the 10th. He used the phrase 'Bolsonaro vacinado' to reinforce his opposition to the party, noting that, unlike his father, he has adopted a more confrontational stance since the beginning of his pre-presidential campaign, still at the end of last year. The gesture was seen as a strategy to mobilize the Bolsonarist base against the Workers' Party.

item.title: A pesquisa e a reclamação de Lula contra o Supremo em ano eleitoral
item.description: President Lula reportedly complained to Supreme Court justices about the potential electoral damage caused by his association with Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli, linked to the Banco Master investigation. He believes the justices’ tarnished image could hurt his 2026 re-election bid, despite publicly defending the Court. Lula also reiterated his longstanding resentment toward Toffoli, whom he appointed in 2009, claiming the justice denied him permission to attend his brother’s funeral while he was imprisoned in the Lava-Jato case.

item.title: Ayrton Senna passa a integrar o Livro dos Heróis e Heroínas da Pátria
item.description: Ayrton Senna was officially recognized as a National Hero following the signing of Law No. 15,447/2026 by President Lula, with his name inscribed in the Book of Heroes and Heroines of the Fatherland, housed in the Pantheon of the Fatherland in Brasília. The tribute, proposed by Senator Marcos Pontes in 2024 and approved by the Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee in March 2026, honors the legacy of the three-time Formula 1 World Champion, making him the 100th individual enshrined in the work. The Ayrton Senna Institute expressed gratitude, emphasizing the enduring impact of his legacy beyond the racetrack.

item.title: O incômodo de uma ala do PDT com as críticas de Kalil ao PT
item.description: A faction within the PDT expressed discomfort with Alexandre Kalil’s criticisms of the PT and President Lula, arguing he was aware of the national alliance between the PDT and Lula’s government before joining the party. Kalil, the pre-candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, ruled out a PT alliance in the first round and maintains an independent candidacy, despite having been seen as a potential beneficiary of PT support. The PDT plans to reinforce its alliance with Lula at a national convention in Brasília on July 20.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso com fuzil no carro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União Brasil), who was arrested with a .556 rifle in his vehicle during the 6th phase of Operation Unha e Carne. He will face charges while under liberty, subject to electronic monitoring, passport surrender, and suspension of firearms rights. The operation investigates money laundering through gas stations and alleged collusion between public officials and criminal factions.

item.title: A distância entre Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas eleitorais divulgadas nesta semana
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 45% to 40% in a potential runoff, maintaining a technical tie within the margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 40.4%, eight points ahead of Flávio at 32%, with 64% of voters already decided and Flávio’s rejection slightly rising. Despite recent political events, voting intentions for the two main candidates remained stable.

item.title: Apesar de Flávio, governo Lula acredita em capítulo final do tarifaço nos próximos dias
item.description: The Lula government believes the final outcome of the tariff hike will occur next Wednesday, with potential for more exceptions but no full rollback. The decision may be influenced by Donald Trump’s fear that the measure could harm the U.S. economy. A possible delay would be seen as a gesture to PL pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who traveled to the U.S. to advocate against the measure to avoid benefiting Lula in the 2026 elections.
